	jxp_is_japanese_polity_trigger = yes
	NOT = { jxp_is_colonial_successor_tag_trigger = yes }
}

jxp_a_has_any_market_stage_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_country_flag = jxp_a_market_stage_1
		has_country_flag = jxp_a_market_stage_2
		has_country_flag = jxp_a_market_stage_3
		has_country_flag = jxp_a_market_stage_4
	}
}

jxp_a_market_state_is_single_trigger = {
	NOT = { AND = { has_country_flag = jxp_a_market_stage_1 has_country_flag = jxp_a_market_stage_2 } }
	NOT = { AND = { has_country_flag = jxp_a_market_stage_1 has_country_flag = jxp_a_market_stage_3 } }
	NOT = { AND = { has_country_flag = jxp_a_market_stage_1 has_country_flag = jxp_a_market_stage_4 } }
	NOT = { AND = { has_country_flag = jxp_a_market_stage_2 has_country_flag = jxp_a_market_stage_3 } }
	NOT = { AND = { has_country_flag = jxp_a_market_stage_2 has_country_flag = jxp_a_market_stage_4 } }

}
